python.note: Use the ComfyUI portable embedded interpreter or the interpreter that owns the selected ComfyUI venv. The installer never installs or replaces Python, torch, CUDA, xformers, or torchvision.

editor.description: CPU mask editor and deterministic mask preparation; no model weights.

sam3.description: Native SAM3 rectangle/video tracking adapter. The Meta checkpoint is gated and must be obtained manually after accepting its license.
manual_notes: This profile installs only the public ComfyUI-SAM3 wrapper; it does not run its optional comfy-env/pixi installer.
The Universal Inpaint adapter requires nodes/_model_cache.py, nodes/sam3_model_patcher.py and the bundled BPE tokenizer.
SAM3 model access is gated on Hugging Face; accept the terms yourself and use HF_TOKEN or an existing hf auth login.

instruction.description: Local Russian-to-English translation for the H3 edit instruction field.
manual_notes: The verified PyTorch checkpoint requires an existing PyTorch 2.6 or newer.

autoprompt.description: Florence-2 PromptGen captioning for the optional AutoPrompt workflow.

h3.description: Native ComfyUI MiniMax H3 workflows and MaskVidExperiments helpers. H3 checkpoints are large; no torch/CUDA replacement is attempted.
manual_notes: H3 execution is delegated to the ComfyUI core node comfy_extras.nodes_minimax_h3; a compatible ComfyUI build is required.
The historical PathchSageAttentionKJ/private runtime is not published as a verified public dependency and is never cloned by this installer.
A successful plan/check does not claim a clean H3 render or visual-quality acceptance.

comfyui-sam3.license: MIT wrapper plus SAM license notices from upstream

sam3.note: Research code and checkpoints are gated; this manifest does not clone or install it separately.
